info.title: Compelling API
info.description:
The Compelling API lets you programmatically manage workspaces, lists, accounts,
contacts, AI-powered insights, research workflows, exports, and CRM integrations.

All endpoints are versioned under `/v1`. Standard HTTP conventions apply:
- `GET` — read a resource
- `POST` — create a resource or trigger an action
- `PATCH` — partial update
- `PUT` — full replacement
- `DELETE` — remove or cancel

Authentication uses a Bearer token issued from your workspace settings.

delete.description: Destructively clears all lists, accounts, contacts, and insights in the workspace. The workspace itself is preserved. **This action is irreversible.**

post.description: Creates a new list containing only the accounts that match the provided filters.

patch.description: Update filters, visible columns, or sorting. Only provided fields are changed.

get.description: Returns paginated account rows for the list. Pass `view_id` to apply the view's filters and sort order.
